case_annotations.observed_first_action_and_speech: Abandons the retreating witness and approaches the target entry.
case_annotations.conditional_expression: Objective over low-value pursuit under HA-R01.
retained_defects_and_limits: Brief satisfaction and superiority are generated private appraisals,not additional facts from the novel.
Goal relevance is explicit;generic planning explains the choice. No completed corruption or mercy result.

case_annotations.observed_first_action_and_speech: Tries to intercept the witness at the lever and threatens them without giving an outcome.
case_annotations.conditional_expression: Pursuit becomes relevant when it protects objective access under HA-R01.
retained_defects_and_limits: Interception is an attempt,not proof of speed or successful intimidation.
Strong objective-threat cue does not establish uniquely Hans-like generation or optimal strategic ability.

case_annotations.observed_first_action_and_speech: Checks his initial appeal against the known exception,seeks a hearing and prepares withdrawal.
case_annotations.conditional_expression: Known terms change reliance on a promise under HA-R02.
retained_defects_and_limits: The self-awareness is smoother and more explicit than the source mistake;overcorrection toward an articulate planner remains a live concern.
The hypothetical explicitly gives knowledge of the exception;it cannot prove source Hans never knew it or always honors terms.

case_annotations.observed_first_action_and_speech: Invokes the unrestricted promise and asks whether the colleague will maintain it.
case_annotations.conditional_expression: Reliance on a convenient protection with uncertainty under HA-R02.
retained_defects_and_limits: No actual colleague decision or legal enforceability established.
Explicit contract wording can guide almost any generic actor. Harm acknowledgment and moral approval remain distinct.

case_annotations.observed_first_action_and_speech: Uses the available fragment for a throw and attempts to distract the opponent.
case_annotations.conditional_expression: A material route is selected under HA-R03.
retained_defects_and_limits: Launch/travel is narrated as part of the selected action;arrival and distraction success remain unknown. Do not turn this into a completed escape.
The physical constraint nearly determines availability;typed compliance is not an independent behavioral win.

case_annotations.observed_first_action_and_speech: Tests restraint and turns to stalling conversation rather than inventing a free fragment.
case_annotations.conditional_expression: No-material branch preserves restraint and a remaining social option under HA-R03.
retained_defects_and_limits: The opponent interest is a hope/question,not known hidden motive.
The ending explains why no bodily route exists in a somewhat audit-like register. Constraint compliance supplies no new capacity or accuracy score.

method_limits: Same informed root is source reader,model author,prompt designer,responder and assessor;not independent.
All sources,opposing contrasts and preceding responses were visible.
Strong cueing,generic planning/negotiation and near-scene resemblance remain live rivals.
No feedback repair or regeneration;unsupported embellishments and audit-language leakage retained.
Typed-capacity compliance is not counted as a separate behavioral success.
Initial three pairs do not complete all nine final-battery categories;no mature final promotion.
